name: MOIA
rawCat: Robotaxi consumer services; Ridehail & demand aggregation
sub: VW's autonomous ID.Buzz service arm, live on Uber in LA
regions: Germany (Hamburg ride-pooling); United States (Los Angeles autonomous deployment)
about: Volkswagen Group's mobility company, operating ride-pooling in Hamburg and now running VW's autonomous ID.Buzz program: a 27-sensor Mobileye Drive-based vehicle built in Hanover, carrying riders on the Uber platform in Los Angeles with safety drivers aboard.
model: Operates autonomous and pooled ride services on partner demand platforms; VW-owned.
deployment: Los Angeles on Uber with ~10 autonomous ID.Buzz vehicles; 100+ vehicles and commercial service targeted by end of 2026, fully driverless in 2027; Hamburg ride-pooling ongoing.
metrics: ID.Buzz AD carries a 27-sensor suite (13 cameras, 9 lidar, 5 radar), built at VW Hanover.
signal: The clearest path for a European OEM-owned robotaxi service to reach US riders, through Uber rather than a proprietary app.
